title: Hearty Romantic Jamaican Pappardelle Pasta
description: A grassy, fluffy, romantic Jamaican dish featuring pappardelle pasta, candy, and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the jerk seasoning to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and candy pieces.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the sauce.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional scallions and candy pieces if desired.
